data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 5 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-5.svg)

Jul 9, 2023

## [Consistency and display of item](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64aacc65c42344628684b70c)
Consistency and display of item - I've been looking at this rug for at least a year, trying to visualize it in my home and making sure it was what I wanted. The fact that it remained in stock for this length of time and the pictures showing the rug in the homes of others, was most helpful for me in finalizing what was a pretty big purchase and commitment for me. I love it!! And...its super soft. I wasn't expected my feet to love it as much as they do!

June 24, 2023
